newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends weaker, fails at highs.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends weaker, fails at highs.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures backed off yesterday's highs to settle lower on profit taking, but prices remained well within their recent trading range.
Producer pricing contributed to weakness in thin volume, estimated at only 10,967 lots.
"The trade is trying to push it down, there was no fund action and we're just sitting in a range," a floor source said.
The market failed to respond to increasing demand out of Brazilian ports, but at least one broker explained the news had already been filtered into the market.
"Most is for (E D & F) Man and it's no surprise that a big chunk of it was already sold," the broker said.
Prices will likely continue to drift within their recent trading range, seen between 10.60 and 11.00 basis March, amid a dearth of news.
The March contract settled 0.05 higher at 10.94, having ranged from 10.97 to 10.89. The back months settled 0.05 lower to 0.02 higher.
Open interest rose only 72 lots to 85,231 lots in the March contract.
